_comment: Copy to aply-config.json to change delivery. Without that file the sandbox and dev run in TEST mode: applications go to the simulated inbox at /outbox and nothing leaves this computer. test_recipient sends EVERY live application to that address instead of the recruiter, so you can test real email delivery safely. Remove it only when you are ready to email real recruiters. Never commit real credentials.

smtp.password: a Gmail app password (not your normal password)
